title: 第6章 前往圣天族地第7章 送礼
content_zh:
“喂，神君，怎么了？”邪帝接通视频通话，画面里出现一个玉树临风，潇洒帅气，阳光的少年。
“哦？大家都在啊。好久不见啊，圣君。”神君看见视频中的画面，他的伙伴皆在邪帝家中，然后就无视了其他人，只跟圣君打招呼。
“好......”圣君话还没说出口，邪帝贱贱的声音就响起，“欧，宝贝，你明明是给我打的电话，你为什么只找她？你都不关心我一下吗？你不知道我昨晚差点九死一生吗？”
“昨晚到底是谁九死一生啊......”炎君回忆了一下昨晚陆家老祖惨死的模样。
“邪帝你给我滚一边去！！”圣君一脚把邪帝踹倒在地上。
“好久不见，你什么时候回来呀？”圣君一副邻家小妹的模样。
邪帝撇撇嘴：“真会装。”
“应该快了吧，我这里遇到些棘手的问题。”
“怎么了，创世神派了什么任务给你。要我帮忙？”邪帝从地上爬了起来疑惑道。
神君在万宇宙中与邪帝齐名，与邪帝同一年击败万宇宙三主神之一光明神，获封神位。虽然他们年龄小就能击败神，但二人资历尚浅，不足为神，故三主神之首创世神会时常给予神君邪帝一些历练使二人成长。
至于二人是如何打败神的，宇宙中至今没有确切的说法，可能知晓的唯有战神几人。
“对的。对了，怎么没看见我妹妹？”
“哥哥我在这。”女帝出现在画面之中。
“？？？你怎么变成这样子了？？邪帝干的？”神君看着女帝现在的样子有点诧异，“这是新战铠还是神魂新形态？”
“对的，邪帝大哥干的。应该算战铠吧，我现在这个形态，差不多掌握了全属性。”女帝思索了一下。
“全属性？那极致精纯圣体真的可以发挥到极致了。”
“YesYes，下次干架我先上。”
“好了，说正事吧。”邪帝接过电话。
“oK，我现在在圣天一族的族地。创世神派我保护圣天一族的族长的女儿——圣天月，并且解决圣天一族的危机。
危机来源于圣天一族的不知道多少年了的仇敌——蛊族。两族皆未入世，算是隐藏势力。我之前已经跟他们交手过了，遇到至刚至阳的力量能轻松抹杀。但他们就胜在人数太多了。

圣天一族人数不够与之抗衡，我的能量只够阻止他们一波攻势。一波攻势至少有千万人。现在蛊族估计马上就要发起最后的进攻了，圣天一族还能战的只有几千人了。我怕我扛不住捏。”神君缓缓道出现在的情况。
“什么抽象任务，创世神没活硬整是吧？那什么圣天月有什么特殊的吗？”邪帝听完吐槽到，“圣天一族？前任剑圣圣天极剑不应该在嘛，他不在嘛？”邪帝问道。
“没有什么特殊的，我也觉得他闲的。圣天极剑前辈的确在，但在闭关，没有出关的迹象。他们族长也没有去唤醒的打算，好像他们觉得有我就够了。但事实并非如此啊，他们还是太高看我了，真干不掉那么多人啊。”神君的语气好像有丝无奈？
“必够了哥们，装菜呢？”邪帝无语了。
“包装的牢弟，看着的人多着呢。”神君嘿嘿一笑。
“知道了，我们5个会一起过来。坐标发给邪帝。”听了半天的老大冰帝开口了。
“好嘞老大。”神君应道。
“老大，你也要去吗？”圣君看着冰帝，有点不放心，毕竟冰帝没有任何修为。冰帝是老大，这是当初长者任命的，长者是九天神国的老国君，也就是圣君的爷爷，那时当然有人不服，但都被邪帝打服了。
“嗯，放心吧，让光儿，影儿，猫女，璃儿在我身边，你们还不放心嘛？”
“行，那好吧。”圣君点点头。冰帝的主意无人敢忤逆。
邪帝的手机上传来神君发的定位。邪帝走到院中央，向空中扔出一张cARd，“明?黑暗炎龙！”，cARd由下自上，穿过邪帝的身体，“吼——”一声龙吼，金闪的烈阳羽翼，全身火红夹杂这黑暗，人形龙铠，由邪帝化为。
魅影，猫女，琉璃化为灵魂体进入邪帝，女帝，炎君的心中。邪帝将冰帝女帝炎君圣君四人捧在一只龙爪中，用自身能量生成一个炎之屏障将冰帝护住。邪帝另一只龙爪向空中一握，空间碎裂出现一个黑洞，邪帝挥动烈阳羽翼，进入了黑洞之中。
......
“盯紧了，神君这几年表现出来的实力与他的传奇不符合啊......”
“是，大人。”
content_en:
"Hey, Lord God, what's going on?" The Evil Emperor connected to the video call, and a handsome, sunny boy appeared on the screen.
"Oh? Everyone is here. Long time no see, Holy Lord." Shenjun saw the scene in the video. His friends were all at the Evil Emperor's home, and then he ignored the others and only greeted the Holy Lord.
"Okay..." Before the Holy Lord could say anything, the Evil Emperor's humble voice rang out, "Oh, baby, you obviously called me, why did you only call her? Don't you even care about me? Don't you know that I almost escaped death last night?"
"Who narrowly escaped death last night..." Yan Jun recalled the tragic death of the ancestor of the Lu family last night.
"Evil Emperor, get out of here!!" The Holy Lord kicked the Evil Emperor to the ground.
"Long time no see, when will you come back?" Shengjun looked like the girl next door.
The Evil Emperor curled his lips: "You really know how to pretend."
"It should be soon. I have some difficult problems here."
"What's wrong? What mission has the God of Creation sent to you? Do you want my help?" the Evil Emperor got up from the ground and asked in confusion.
The Divine Lord is as famous as the Evil Emperor in the universe. In the same year as the Evil Emperor, he defeated the God of Light, one of the three main gods of the universe, and was granted the title of god. Although they can defeat gods at a young age, they are still inexperienced and not enough to become gods. Therefore, the Creation God, the first of the three main gods, often gives the Divine Lord and Evil Emperor some experience to help them grow.
As for how the two defeated the gods, there is no exact explanation in the universe. Only the God of War and a few others may know.
"Yes. By the way, why didn't you see my sister?"
"Brother, I'm here." The empress appeared on the screen.
"???How did you become like this?? Did the Evil Emperor do it?" The Lord God looked a little surprised at the empress' current appearance, "Is this a new armor or a new form of the soul?"
"Yes, Brother Evil Emperor did it. It should be considered a battle armor. In my current form, I have almost mastered all attributes." The empress thought for a moment.
"Full attributes? That extremely pure holy body can really be used to its extreme."
"YesYes, next time we fight, I will go first."
"Okay, let's get down to business." Evil Emperor answered the phone.
"OK, I am now in the clan of the Shengtian clan. The God of Creation sent me to protect the daughter of the patriarch of the Shengtian clan, Shengtian Yue, and to solve the crisis of the Shengtian clan.
The crisis comes from the Gu clan, the enemies of the Shengtian clan for who knows how many years. Both tribes have not yet joined the world, so they are considered hidden forces. I have fought against them before, and I can easily wipe them out when I encounter them with the most powerful force. But their victory was that there were too many of them.
The Shengtian clan doesn't have enough people to contend with them, and my energy is only enough to stop one wave of their attacks. There are at least ten million people in one wave of offensive. Now the Gu clan is expected to launch the final attack soon, and the Shengtian clan can only fight with a few thousand people. I'm afraid I won't be able to bear it. "The Lord God slowly revealed the current situation.
"What an abstract mission? The God of Creation didn't live up to it, right? Is there anything special about Sheng Tianyue?" After hearing this, the Evil Emperor complained, "The Shengtian Clan? The former Sword Master Sheng Tianji Sword shouldn't be here, isn't he?" the Evil Emperor asked.
"There's nothing special, and I think he's free. Senior Sheng Tian Ji Sword is indeed here, but he is in seclusion and has no signs of leaving. Their clan leader has no intention of awakening him. It seems that they think that having me is enough. But this is not the case. They still think too highly of me. They really can't kill so many people." The tone of Shenjun seemed helpless?
"That's enough, brother, where are the dishes?" The Evil Emperor was speechless.
"There are a lot of people watching the packaging cell." Shenjun chuckled.
"I know, the five of us will come together. Send the coordinates to the Evil Emperor." The boss, Ice Emperor, who had been listening for a long time, spoke.
"Okay, boss." Shenjun responded.
"Boss, are you going too?" Shengjun looked at the Ice Emperor and asked.I'm not worried at all, after all, the Ice Emperor doesn't have any cultivation base. The Ice Emperor is the boss. This was appointed by the elder who was the old king of the Nine Heavens Kingdom and the grandfather of the Holy Lord. Of course, some people were dissatisfied at that time, but they were all defeated by the Evil Emperor.
"Well, don't worry. Aren't you still worried if Guang'er, Ying'er, Catwoman, and Li'er are by my side?"
"Okay, okay then." The Holy Lord nodded. No one dares to disobey the Ice Emperor.
The location of Shen Junfa was uploaded to Evil Emperor's cell phone. The Evil Emperor walked to the center of the courtyard and threw a cARd into the air, "Light? Dark Flame Dragon!", the cARd went from bottom to top, passing through the Evil Emperor's body, "Roar--" a dragon roar, golden shining sun wings, the whole body was fiery red mixed with this darkness, and the humanoid dragon armor was transformed from the Evil Emperor.
Phantom, Catwoman, and Liuli transformed into soul bodies and entered the hearts of the Evil Emperor, Empress, and Yanjun. The Evil Emperor held the four Ice Emperors, Empress Yanjun and Saint Lord, in a dragon claw, and used his own energy to generate a barrier of fire to protect the Ice Emperor. The Evil Emperor held his other dragon claw in the air, and the space shattered into a black hole. The Evil Emperor waved his blazing sun wings and entered the black hole.
...
"Keep an eye on it, the strength that Lord Shen has shown in recent years is not in line with his legend..."
"Yes, sir."
